rundown: Texans beat Colts 26-3 at Reliant Stadium in Houston, TX in front of 70,942. Texans led 17-3 at the half and never looked back. The 2nd quarter decided it: Texans won it 10-0.
Scoring: Colts 0 touchdowns and 1 field goal; Texans 3 touchdowns and 1 field goal. The last score: Marlin Klein 13 Yd pass from C.J. Stroud (Ka'imi Fairbairn Kick) (3rd quarter, 4:19).

Leading the way — Colts: Daniel Jones 12/27, 144 yds, 1 INT; Jonathan Taylor 11 car, 21 yds; Anthony Gould 2 rec, 48 yds. Texans: C.J. Stroud 21/27, 194 yds, 3 TD, 1 INT; David Montgomery 26 car, 107 yds; Nico Collins 3 rec, 58 yds, 1 TD.
Where Texans won it: they outgained them 354 yards to 167 and held the ball 37:46 to 22:14.
Against the closing line (DraftKings): Texans closed as 12.5-point favorites and covered by 10.5; the total closed at 44.5 and they combined for 29, under by 15.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 19, 8:13 PM ET. It had Colts 26% and Texans 74%, projecting Colts 20 – Texans 28.5 (48.5 total, Texans by 8.5).

Final: Colts 3 – Texans 26. Right winner: it had Texans at 74%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Colts came in with a 7% below average attack and a 5% leakier than average defense (3-7, 20.8 scored and 27.1 allowed a game over 10 games), worth about 55 and 54 games of evidence. Projected to score 20, they scored 3 (−17 points, 85% under); projected to allow 28.5, they allowed 26 (−2.5 points, 9% under).

Texans came in with a 4% above average attack and a 6% stingier than average defense (3-6, 25.9 scored and 24.3 allowed a game over 9 games), worth about 52 and 52 games of evidence. Projected to score 28.5, they scored 26 (−2.5 points, 9% under); projected to allow 20, they allowed 3 (−17 points, 85% under).

The bigger miss was Colts' scoring (-17 points against projection); both sides underscored their projections, so the game ran colder than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 29 against 48.5 projected (-19.5), about the 7th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±13.2).

Margin: Texans by 23 against Texans by 8.5 projected, about the 87th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±12.8).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Market (Line movement signal): Texans ×1.02, Colts ×1.00. It favored Texans, who did beat their projection by more than the other side did.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
HOU ML (-750) at -750: the algo gave it 84% vs 85% fair (-0.9 pts) — won (+0.1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 85%). IND ML (+533) at +533: the algo gave it 16% vs 15% fair (+0.9 pts), THE PICK — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 15%). HOU -12.5 (-111) at -111: the algo gave it 49% vs 50% fair (-1.3 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close. IND +12.5 (-108) at -108: the algo gave it 51% vs 50% fair (+1.3 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. OVER 44.5 (-104) at -104: the algo gave it 50% vs 49% fair (+1.3 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. UNDER 44.5 (-116) at -116: the algo gave it 50% vs 51% fair (-1.3 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 46% of bets on Colts, 40% of the money — Texans covered; total: 75% of bets on the over, 71% of the money — it went under; moneyline: 9% of bets on Colts, 27% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Texans, who won and covered.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.594 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +13.2 points. It counts toward NFL scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 43 graded NFL games the algo now scales scoring ×0.982 and gives home teams -1.3 points. Team corrections so far: Colts attack ×0.960, defense ×1.016 (4 games); Texans attack ×1.038, defense ×0.960 (4 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total outside its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 14.5 points), the pick lost (-1u).
